exclusions: Local profiles and one-pair smoke are diagnostics, including their recorded dirty source state.
Smoke headers say repetitions=5, but only one sample is recorded and run_completed=false.
Provider polling metadata is a snapshot; no pending run outcome or future CI artifact is asserted.
Issuer keys, raw NDJSON, sessions, full-index/result duplicates and baseline content are omitted.
Historical SHA256SUMS and witness manifests may refer to omitted blobs; the new package manifest defines included bytes.
This preserves diagnostic records/review helpers, not a complete raw-input/kernel replay environment.
